basic_info.description: Located in the heart of iconic Telegraph Hill, this updated 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and city living. Set within a luxury building, this nearly 600 sq ft home features brand-new pre-engineered hardwood flooring, plush new carpet in the bedroom, fresh paint throughout, and elegant new baseboards — making it truly move-in ready. Enjoy a peek of the Bay from your window, and take advantage of premium amenities including 24-hour security and doorman service, a modern fitness center, club room with full kitchen, guest suite, and free laundry facilities on every floor. Secure underground parking adds extra peace of mind. With a Walk Score of 87, you're just steps from vibrant North Beach restaurants, shops, public transportation, and the waterfront excitement of Pier 39. Whether you're a first-time buyer, or seeking the ideal city pied-à-terre, this is a must-see opportunity in one of San Francisco’s most desirable neighborhoods.
